ACCEPTANCE AND MODIFICATION

-The Purchase Order constitutes Buyer's offer to Supplier and becomes a binding contract on the terms set forth herein when accepted by acknowledgment or commencement of performance by Supplier.

-No revision, modification, or waiver of any of the terms and conditions of this Purchase Order shall be binding on Buyer unless made in writing and signed by an authorized representative of Buyer.

PRICE AND PAYMENT

-Prices stated in the Purchase Order shall be fixed and not subject to variation.

-Invoices must quote the Purchase Order number and be submitted to Buyer's accounts department.

-Buyer reserves the right to withhold payment for disputed invoices until resolution.

DELIVERY AND PERFORMANCE.

-Supplier shall immediately notify Buyer in writing of any anticipated delay in delivery or completion.

-Buyer reserves the right to cancel the Purchase Order or any part thereof without penalty if Supplier fails to deliver as scheduled.

-Confirm all descriptions and specifications provided

-Suppliers shall maintain all necessary licenses, certifications, and permissions required to provide the Services.

-Any defective product shall be replaced at no additional cost to Buyer.

CONFIDENTIALITY

-Supplier shall keep confidential all technical or commercial information obtained from Buyer.

-Confidentiality obligations shall survive the completion or termination of the Purchase Order.

LIABILITY AND INDEMNIFICATION

-Supplier shall indemnify Buyer against all damages, costs, claims, and expenses arising from:

-Any breach of these terms and conditions

-Any negligent or wrongful act of the Supplier

-Any defect in the Services provided

-Supplier shall maintain adequate insurance coverage for its obligations under this Purchase Order.

TERMINATION

-Buyer may terminate the Purchase Order as a whole or in part at any time by written notice to Supplier.

-Upon termination, Supplier shall:

-Cease all work on the Purchase Order

-Deliver to Buyer all completed or partially completed Deliverables

-Buyers shall pay for all Services properly performed up to the date of termination.

FORCE MAJEURE

-Neither party shall be liable for delays due to causes beyond their reasonable control.

-The affected party shall promptly notify the other party of any such delay.

COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS

-Suppliers shall comply with all applicable laws, regulations, and standards.

-Suppliers shall obtain and maintain all necessary permits and licenses.
